en.headline: Lola María opens second branch in Wan Chai on 3 November
en.dek: Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona’s Spanish eatery expands from Sheung Wan to Gresson Street, about nine months after the original opened.
body: Lola María is set to open a second branch in Wan Chai on 3 November, roughly nine months after its first location debuted on Hollywood Road in Sheung Wan.
The new outlet will be at Shop A, G/F, Wai Cheong Building, 5–9A Gresson Street. Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona runs the Spanish eatery, which focuses on straightforward bread-and-butter dishes.
The original Sheung Wan branch opened in March. The Wan Chai location continues the same approach in a second neighbourhood.

zh.headline: Lola María 11月3日於灣仔開第二分店
zh.dek: 西班牙菜館由上環荷李活道擴展至灣仔機利臣街，距離首店開業約九個月。
body: Lola María 將於11月3日在灣仔開設第二分店，距離其上環荷李活道首店開業約九個月。
新店位於灣仔機利臣街5至9A號偉昌大廈地下A舖。主廚 Edgard Sanuy Barahona 經營這間以簡單西班牙料理為主的菜館。
首店於今年3月在上環開業。灣仔分店將延續相同風格，在另一個社區提供服務。
